### 🟡 Changes recommended The new sanitization configuration wiring lacks agent-backed coverage through the real initialization path.
1 open finding - [Add agent-backed coverage for DbConfig sanitization settings](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/20478#discussion_r4233336415) · New
What changed in this PR Adopts shared SQL analysis for Couchbase 2.x SQL++ queries while preserving generic handling for key-value and view operations. **Changes:** - Routes SQL queries through a dedicated SQL getter and instrumenter. - Updates telemetry assertions and query extraction tests. - Expands Geode sanitization coverage and documents the breaking telemetry change. | File | [Testing] The new sanitization coverage constructs `SqlClientAttributesExtractor` directly, so it never exercises this `DbConfig` lookup or the singleton/instrumenter selection used by an installed agent. A regression in the Couchbase flat, declarative, or inherited common setting could therefore leave `db.query.text` masked while these tests still pass. Please add agent-backed coverage that disables sanitization through the real configuration path and asserts raw `db.query.text` while the query summary and span name remain derived.
